newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar down, July holds support.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar down, July holds support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures eased by midsession in rangebound activity as players rolled May contracts into July, dealers said.

Scale-down trade buying blunted losses and held the most-active July contract above its downside target of 11.00 cents. Prices are expected to remain within the current range ahead of the last trading day for May sugar on Wednesday.
"No one is willing to sell anything of any size," a market source said.
Support below 11.00 cents in July was pegged at 10.91 cents, the low hit last week. Sell stops are expected to be resting underneath, floor sources said.
Firm resistance was pegged at 11.20 cents basis July, where producer selling is expected to limit gains.
At 1130 EDT, the most-active July contract was down 0.06 cent at 11.08 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.12 to 11.01 cents. May eased 0.01 to 11.54, while the back months stood 0.06 to 0.01 lower.
Estimated volume as of 1100 EDT was 12,429 lots.
Open interest in May fell 1,533 lots to 24,774 lots as of early Friday. July gained 298 lots to 85,769 lots.
Rain in France over the weekend is expected to help the germination conditions of the country's sugar beet crop, which has suffered under a three month drought, farmers said.
A lack of significant physical offtake contributed to the market's dull tone, trading sources said.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
